title: A score that climbs with you, and a Dark that won't wait
notes: The music now follows your climb: it moves between sections, the bass comes in at your first landing and the drums at your second, the melody joins on a streak of three perfects, a landing swells into a new section, and a topple strips it back.
Stay on a sky past its par time and the Dark quickens, faster every ten seconds. Perfect drops still push it back, but never more than twelve floors below you.
